== Biography ==
Eliza was born in 1847.  She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-665|James Glasgow]] and [[Douglass-1765|Elizabeth Douglass]].  She passed away in 1926, and was buried at Pleasant Hill United Methodist Church Cemetery, Glasgow, Cambria County, Pennsylvania, in Section 21, Plot 189.<ref>[https://secure.findagrave.com/cgi-bin/fg.cgi?page=gr&GRid=29770106 Find A Grave Memorial# 29770106]</ref>

=== Obituary ===
Mrs. John Troxell (Eliza Glasgow) of Glasgow, died at 79 on May 2, 1926. Surviving are her husband, daughter Mrs. Alice McClellan Glasgow, son Harry of Montana and these brothers and sisters; John and James of Glasgow, Mrs. Hannah Brown of Coalport, Mrs. Sarah Gates of Pittsburgh, Mrs. Melissa Keller of Glasgow, Mrs. Edith Frye of "Punxy" (Punxautawney), Mrs. Caroline Irwin of Blandburg, and Mrs. Emma Frye of Williamsburg. Interment at Pleasant Hill Cemetery, Glasgow..<ref>''Altoona Tribune'', Altoona, Pennsylvania.  May 3, 1926.</ref>
